title: The Decisive Doubling
setup: Your rook and queen are doubled on the open d-file. Black's rook guards the back rank, with its queen on c7 standing behind it.
hint: Two attackers against two defenders on one square. Trade the front pieces and see which piece is left standing.
explanation:
## The Idea

Doubling on an open file is arithmetic. Two white pieces hit d8, and two black pieces guard it.

{{Rxd8+}} starts the count with check, and {{Qxd8}} is the only legal reply. Then {{Qxd8#}} recaptures with mate: f8 and h8 are on the queen's rank, and f7, g7 and h7 hold Black's pawns.

When the counts are equal, the side that captures first keeps the last piece on the square.
